x: Len Bishop also coming into the team as a reserve, had the unenviable task of coping with Douglas of the Beagles and Ralph Dunkley of the Poly and although he drove himself to the last ounce, he was forced to give ground to this pair and to Porter of Finchley and we were once more back to fourth.
John Thresher ran his usual sound 1500, but was not to know that one of his conquerors (Douglas) would shortly annexe the Southern 1500 mile title and then do 3:58.5 for a mile.
Not only did we know about them, of course, but it transpired that our enquirer was still in touch with one of his relations - Douglas Gordon.
